issue_data.body:
We render user-generated content (forum posts) with mistune. For SEO-spam reasons we need every link to carry `rel="nofollow ugc"`. Right now we post-process the HTML with a regex, which is fragile. Could the HTML renderer get an option for this? Something like: ```python renderer = mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc") md = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer, plugins=["url"]) md("[site](https://example.com)") #

site

``` It should apply to every `` the renderer produces (normal links, `` autolinks, plain URLs from the url plugin). Images shouldn't be affected. Default behaviour (no option) should stay exactly as it is today. Happy to test a PR. Thanks for the great library!
